title: バクシン的トレーニング……？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day while training for speed, our hearts set on gaining a major win against Nishino Flower…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I've finished my bench presses!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I don't need a break! I still have a lot in me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What exercise should I do next…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hm! I sense some eyes upon us!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hoo! You scared me there!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What's the matter you two? You're staring pretty hard at me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Although I do understand not wanting to take your eyes off an exceptionally hard worker like myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gah! Are you perhaps researching me as your rival?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, I was just thinking that… you're really giving it your all, Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! You have come to compliment me then, as I thought. Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If speed's what you have in mind, training like this is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Intensive training course spotted, effective for rapid muscle growth…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Conclusive evidence that hard work and training is the fastest possible route to becoming the Sprint Champion.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The Sprint Champion?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No, you've got the wron—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You've done so well in your sprints… It's truly amazing.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, Bourbon and I will be cheering you on, so… Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Fear not! I completely understand what you're doing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: All of this is to push my speed to the limits and help me claim victory everywhere I go on my Bakushin Road.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right! So, yes, I'm okay…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm not worried that you're making me into a sprinter or anything, so rest easy!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nor am I thinking about how Rice hasn't been in any of my races lately!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yup! Let's get back to training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is all so we can win, and that is the one thing we firmly agree on.
